textos.texto: Good morning! Excuse me, what is your name? My name is Ana. How old are you? I am twenty years old. Thank you. And your phone number? It is four, seven, two, nine, one, three, eight. Four, seven, two, nine, one, three, eight. Yes! And your birthday? It is in May. Very well. And Paul, how old is he? Paul is twenty-two. Laura is nineteen years old. Mr Lee is fifty and Mrs Lee is forty. Thank you very much! You're welcome. See you soon!

Escribe el primer número del teléfono de Ana.
Mr Lee y Mrs Lee tienen la misma edad.

textos.texto: Good afternoon! Your name, please? My name is Laura. How old are you? I am nineteen years old. Thank you. And your birthday? It is in May too. And your phone number? It is zero, five, one, six, eight, ten. Zero, five, one, six, eight, ten. Yes! Excuse me, is Marc thirty? No, Marc is thirty-one. Sorry! No problem. Mr Lee is sixty and Mrs Lee is seventy. And one hundred? One hundred is not an age! Eleven, twelve, thirteen, fourteen, fifteen, sixteen, seventeen, eighteen, eighty, ninety: I have all the numbers here. Very well, Laura. Have a nice day! Thank you, and you!
